description: This Java class provides utility methods for exporting data tables, including filename normalization, report filename generation, and S3-compatible filename generation with timestamp suffixes, handling folder and report parameters.

classes.name: DatatableExportUtil
classes.description: A utility class for generating and normalizing filenames for data export purposes in the Fineract project.

methods.name: normalizeFolderName
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes folder names by replacing special characters, collapsing multiple slashes, and removing leading dots or slashes.

methods.name: generatePlainExportFileName
methods.description: Creates a report filename with a specified maximum length, extension, report name, and parameters.

methods.name: generateS3DatatableExportFileName
methods.description: Generates an S3-compatible filename with folder structure, timestamp, and name normalization.

methods.name: exportBasicValidation
methods.description: Validates that extension and report name are provided.

methods.name: generateReportFileName
methods.description: Constructs the report filename with timestamp and parameter encoding, ensuring it fits within max length.

methods.name: extractReportParameterKey
methods.description: Extracts the key name from parameter strings formatted as ${key}.
